# Bibliography

**This table is generated. Do not edit it by hand.** It is written by `scripts/build_bibliography.py` in the private companion repository from the works master (`references/_meta/_works.json`, built by `scripts/build_works_master.py`), and `scripts/check_works.py` fails when this file and the master disagree. Corrections go into the master's sources (the per-file records, the link shards, the inbox READMEs), then both scripts are run again.

One row per work held. A work held as several files (chunks, an OCR copy, a second copy) is one row. The PDFs stay in the private repository; the private path is given so the maintainer can find the file, and is not a link.

Status: **verified** means the linked record's title matches the title page of the held PDF (at least 80 percent of the tokens, or the DOI printed in the PDF) and the author and year agree; **candidate** means a likely link that does not meet that rule; **unresolved** means a search found nothing that can be linked; **not searched** means no search has been run yet.

Counts: works 746; files 823; verified 427; candidates 95; unresolved 220; not searched 4; held but not listed 1 (reasons in the private master report).

### Notes on scope

- These entries come from a pass over the citation lists of the held works, done on 2026-04-15.
- The current short list is only the reconciled Tier-1 follow-up. It is **not** the full set of cited-but-not-held works.
- That pass found **319** author-year references cited at least 5 times in the held works and not yet listed in this file. Many of those will be duplicates, edition mismatches, series shorthands, or already-held works under different filenames, so they must be reconciled gradually rather than dumped in blindly.

## Maintenance notes

- New PDFs go into `references/<subpath>/` in the private companion repository. The intake index and this file are updated in the same commit.
- When a "(verify)" entry is confirmed against the title page, edit the citation here.
- The PDFs stay in the private companion repository. This file carries a public source URL for an entry where one is known.
